props.buyingPitch: We'll tell you straight whether we'd buy on {street} — and if we wouldn't, which streets in {suburb} (or nearby) we'd look at instead, and why.
props.ownPitch: You already hold the asset. In 15 minutes we'll walk through what the street-level data means for its value, whether it's dragging on your portfolio, and what the sensible next move looks like.
props.rentHeading: Want the rent-vs-buy numbers for you?
props.rentPitch: No hard sell. If you'd like, we'll run the rentvesting maths for your situation — keep renting where you want to live, buy where the numbers work.
props.consentIntro: How should we follow up? Both are optional — the Review itself needs neither.
props.noSalesLine: No sales call unless you book one.
props.doneCopy: Got it. Pick a time below and we'll bring {street} — and any other streets you're weighing up — to the call.
props.curiousCopy: We'll email you if {street}'s score moves.
